sentences.text: Mr. Ankit Agarwala Mr. Alotriya Mukherjee ... for the petitioners Mr. Madhusudan Sur, ld.

APP Mr.
Manoranjan Mahata ... for the State Affidavit-of-service filed be kept with the record.
In spite of due service there is no representation on behalf of the opposite party no. 2.
Learned counsel for the State who has placed the case diary is present.

The present revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing of the proceeding being Uttarpara P.S. Case No. 254 of 2020 dated 26th August, 2020 under Sections 498A/420/120B/323/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code corresponding to G.R. Case No. 1116 of 2020, presently pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Serampore,
Hooghly.

entities.text:
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Serampore,
Hooghly
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the proceeding in the present case was initiated on 26.08.2020.
Subsequently, a matrimonial suit being no. 465 of 2022 was filed by the parties under Section 28 of the Special Marriage Act, 1954 praying for a decree of divorce on mutual consent.

In the said application under Section 28 of the Special Marriage Act, the terms and conditions for amicable settlement between the parties and also withdrawal of all the cases between the parties was clearly laid down.
By an order dated 07.07.2023 the said marriage between the parties was dissolved by a decree of divorce on mutual consent.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that in spite of the petitioner/husband making payments as agreed upon, the opposite party no. 2 has withdrawn only some applications praying for maintenance but is now not willing to withdraw the present proceeding.

A report to that effect has been filed by the State wherein it has been stated that the appointed lawyer of the petitioner namely Alotrita Mukherjee is creating pressure upon the complainant Swarnali Basu (Banerjee) to withdraw the case without returning the stridhan articles as the petitioner Srinjoy Basu raised objection to operate the bank locker lying at State Bank of India Super mart 1, DLF Phase-IV Gurugram Hariyana 122002 where the stridhan articles are lying and the complainant Swarnali Basu (Banerjee) is unable to collect her stridhan articles out of her life risk.
In view of the said statements in the report submitted by the police, the mater be fixed for further orders on 17.06.2024.
